Tom lives in a country house with his family. His house is big and beautiful. There are three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a large living room. In the living room, there is a sofa, a table and a TV. His bedroom is next to the bathroom. Tom lives with his parents and his sister. He likes his house because it is quiet and near nature. He often reads books in the living room.

QUICK REVIEW - KIẾN THỨC NÒNG CỐT UNIT 2

1. Từ vựng trọng tâm:
  • Types of house: flat, country house, villa, town house.
  • Rooms & Furniture: living room, kitchen, bedroom, sofa, lamp, cupboard.
2. Ngữ pháp mấu chốt:
  • There is + N danh từ số ít (Ex: There is a lamp).
  • There are + N danh từ số nhiều (Ex: There are three chairs).
  • Giới từ chỉ vị trí: in, on, under, behind, next to, in front of.
  • Sở hữu cách: Nick's room.
